title: OpenAssistant Conversations - Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment
authors_zh: Andreas Köpf、Yannic Kilcher、Dimitri von Rütte、Sotiris Anagnostidis、Zhi-Rui Tam、Keith Stevens、Abdullah Barhoum、Nguyen Minh Duc、Oliver Stanley、Richárd Nagyfi、Shahul ES、Sameer Suri、David Glushkov、Arnav Dantuluri、Andrew Maguire、Christoph Schuhmann、Huu Nguyen、Alexander Mattick
paper_type_zh: 后训练数据、偏好、奖励或评测研究
best_for_zh: 研究 LLM 后训练反馈数据与 verifier 的读者。
one_line: OpenAssistant Conversations - Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment addresses open conversational alignment data.
OpenAssistant Conversations 构建并公开了 OASST1，包含约 16.1 万条消息、35 种语言、46.1 万个质量评分和一万余棵完整对话树，可用于指令微调、奖励模型训练和人类偏好对齐。
why: It exposes a feedback, preference, reward, rubric, safety, or post-training data surface that must be audited before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Candidate paper on open conversational alignment data with an official arXiv primary link.

title: Problem
问题
html: OpenAssistant Conversations is a release of interaction structure as well as text. The 161,443 messages are arranged in more than 10,000 conversation trees, allowing one user request to have multiple assistant continuations and later turns. A message-level row is therefore not self-contained: it inherits the path before it, may have siblings with comparative ratings, and can affect how a derived training example should be split. This is why the paper belongs in an alignment-data card rather than merely an instruction corpus list.
OpenAssistant Conversations 发布的不只是文本，还包括交互结构。161,443 条消息被组织为超过 10,000 棵对话树，使同一用户请求可以拥有多个助手续写和后续轮次。因此一条消息级记录并不自足：它继承之前路径，可能有带比较评分的兄弟节点，还会影响派生训练样本应如何切分。这也是它应被放入对齐数据卡、而不只是指令语料清单的原因。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The 461,292 quality ratings create several possible supervision views. One may use high-rated assistant nodes for SFT, compare siblings for preference learning, train a critic on ratings, or sample full root-to-leaf trajectories for dialogue modeling. These choices are not equivalent. A pair made from siblings holds prompt and history fixed; a pair made from different trees may confound quality with topic, language, or context. The tree is the contract that lets a downstream user make this distinction.
461,292 条质量评分形成多种不同监督视图：可将高分助手节点用于 SFT，将兄弟节点用于偏好学习，用评分训练批评器，或采样完整根到叶轨迹做对话建模。这些选择并不等价。由兄弟节点构造的回答对固定了提示与历史；由不同树构造的对可能把质量与主题、语言或上下文混在一起。树结构正是让下游使用者能作此区分的契约。

title: Method
方法
html: The collection is a worldwide crowdsourcing effort involving more than 13,500 volunteers and 35 languages. Contributors author prompts and responses in an assistant-style interface, then provide quality feedback. Before training, a curator must decide which roles and turns to include, how to handle multiple children, which rating threshold or aggregation to use, and whether to preserve language as metadata. The official oasst1 artifact and repository document the data schema; a reproducible derived set should retain original message IDs and parent IDs.
该集是超过 13,500 名志愿者参与的全球众包工作，覆盖 35 种语言。贡献者在助手式界面中写提示与回答，再提供质量反馈。训练前，策展者必须决定保留哪些角色和轮次、如何处理多个子节点、使用怎样的评分阈值或聚合、是否保留语言元数据。官方 oasst1 工件和仓库说明了 schema；可复现派生集应保留原始 message ID 与 parent ID。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports that models trained on OpenAssistant Conversations consistently improve over corresponding base models on standard benchmarks. That result supports the usefulness of open human-created alignment data, but it is not a universal quality certificate for every node. The corpus contains a mixture of languages, tasks, contributors, and rating situations, and performance changes depend on the model, traversal policy, filtering, and benchmark. A meaningful report should say which derived subset was used rather than simply citing “OASST.”
论文报告，在 OpenAssistant Conversations 上训练的模型相对对应基座模型在标准基准上稳定提升。这支持开放人类创作对齐数据的价值，却不是对每个节点的通用质量保证。语料混合了语言、任务、贡献者和评分情境，表现会随模型、树遍历政策、过滤和基准而变。严肃报告必须说明使用了哪个派生子集，而不能只写“用了 OASST”。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution predates many later preference datasets but remains distinctive because it publicly releases branching, rated conversations under a permissive framework. Proprietary RLHF logs often expose neither the alternatives nor the conversation topology. The novelty is not that people can rate answers; it is that the release preserves enough lineage to reconstruct alternative supervision objects. It does not imply that every volunteer vote is an expert preference or that tree structure resolves annotation disagreement.
该工作早于许多后续偏好集，但仍因公开“有评分的分支对话”而独特。专有 RLHF 日志通常既不公开替代回答，也不公开对话拓扑。新意不是人可以给回答评分，而是发布保留了足够血缘来重建不同监督对象；这不表示每一张志愿者票都是专家偏好，也不表示树结构自动解决了标注分歧。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Tree data has specific leakage hazards. If a train example uses one child and a test example uses its sibling, the model has seen most of the context and may have seen an almost identical answer. Multilingual paths can also have uneven quality, and volunteers can include unsafe, biased, or personal content. Filtering by ratings may over-select particular writing styles. Audit at the tree and language levels, not only at the flattened-row level.
树数据有特定泄漏风险：训练若使用一个子节点、测试使用其兄弟节点，模型已看过绝大部分上下文，甚至看过几乎相同的回答。多语种路径质量也可能不均，志愿者内容可能含不安全、偏见或个人信息。按评分过滤还可能过度选择某类写作风格。审计必须在树和语言层面进行，而不只在压平后的行层面进行。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the release for open assistant SFT, preference-pair construction, response-quality modeling, multilingual conversation analysis, and experiments on tree traversal. It is particularly valuable when a researcher needs to compare a best-branch SFT recipe with a sibling-pair DPO recipe using the same raw source. It should not be treated as a curated clinical, legal, safety, or benchmark-decontaminated corpus without additional screening.
该发布可用于开放助手 SFT、偏好对构造、回答质量建模、多语种对话分析和树遍历实验。它尤其适合比较“最佳分支 SFT 配方”与“兄弟对 DPO 配方”，因为二者可使用同一原始来源。没有额外筛选时，不应把它当作临床、法律、安全或已做基准去污染的语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: A reading and replication log should include the dataset revision, message and tree counts after filtering, languages retained, turn-depth policy, parent/child traversal, rating aggregation, tie handling, prompt template, license, and split key. Store a table mapping every derived example back to its message IDs. This provenance is essential when a later experiment asks whether a gain came from more context, higher-rated answers, or a different preference-pair construction.
阅读与复现日志应包含数据版本、过滤后的消息/树数量、保留语言、轮次深度政策、父子遍历、评分聚合、并列处理、提示模板、许可和切分键。应保存把每个派生样本映射回 message ID 的表。这种来源记录对回答后续问题至关重要：性能提升是来自更多上下文、更高评分回答，还是不同的偏好对构造？

引用

The primary paper is https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.07327; the official implementation is https://github.com/LAION-AI/Open-Assistant and the canonical oasst1 release is https://huggingface.co/datasets/OpenAssistant/oasst1. Check the chosen revision’s data card and license before redistributing a derivative.
